meta.design: 30 节点中英混合 + 10 query（跨语/纯中/纯英三分）；英文 query 的中文命中只能靠统一归一层（beef→牛肉 跨语词法），故它同时是 MDCG_UNIFY_QUERY 转正证据面

nodes.title: 牛肉面记录
nodes.body: 昨天中午在巷口吃了牛肉面，汤头浓郁，老板说牛肉是清晨从市场买的新鲜牛腱

nodes.title: 羊肉炉聚会
nodes.body: 上周五同事聚餐点了羊肉炉，羊肉炖得很烂，大家喝了一点米酒驱寒

nodes.title: 灵枢热缓存设计
nodes.body: 灵枢记忆库的热缓存在构造时按开关挂载，重复查询命中缓存后不再扫盘，热路径缓存键含口径参数

nodes.title: 蜂群调度器
nodes.body: 蜂群调度器按 workers 上限领取任务，依赖门禁在领取前检查上游终态，冲突闸放行无法比对场景并留审计

nodes.title: 检索门控收敛
nodes.body: 检索门控把候选先按域收敛再进打分，召回安全不变量要求命中不足即回退不收敛，orphan 节点恒留兜底池

nodes.title: 令牌验签
nodes.body: 令牌验签失败必须拒绝启动，凭据面泄露要脱敏，审计记录存哈希不存明文载荷

nodes.title: 心脏复查
nodes.body: 母亲约了周三上午的心脏复查，医生嘱咐复查前一天晚上十点后不要进食，带上上次的报告

nodes.title: 孩子学琴
nodes.body: 孩子每周六下午学钢琴，老师布置了新的练习曲，要求每天练琴半小时再玩

nodes.title: 数据库迁移
nodes.body: 数据库迁移采用双写方案，先历史回填再切读，备份策略是每日全量加每半小时增量

nodes.title: 评审纪律
nodes.body: 评审人必须与编译人不同主体，自证拒绝要求验证方独立，判据指纹随提案落盘

nodes.title: 火锅周末
nodes.body: 这周末想去吃火锅，上次那家麻辣锅底太辣，换一家清汤菌菇锅，顺便逛逛商场

nodes.title: 雨伞维修
nodes.body: 门口的雨伞骨架断了，修伞师傅说周五能修好，取伞时记得带收据

nodes.title: 火车票
nodes.body: 下月去北京的火车票开售了，买早上八点的高铁，靠窗的座位，回程买晚上的

nodes.title: 写侧闸门
nodes.body: 写入闸门检查凭据与冲突，写通道双轨制区分人工与自动写入，落盘后失效查询缓存

nodes.title: 退休计划
nodes.body: 父亲开始规划退休生活，想学摄影和钓鱼，还打算把老家的院子重新翻修

nodes.title: Compiler tests
nodes.body: The compiler generates candidates from dialog and writes regression tests for every fused path

nodes.title: Review independence
nodes.body: Reviewers must be independent from compilers, the verdict fingerprint is stored with each proposal

nodes.title: Hot cache
nodes.body: Hot cache speeds up repeated queries, the cache key includes all semantics changing parameters

nodes.title: Dependency gate
nodes.body: Dependency gate checks upstream final states before a worker claims the job

nodes.title: Token verification
nodes.body: Token verification is fail closed on any mismatch, credentials must be redacted in logs

nodes.title: Memory recall
nodes.body: Memory recall fuses four retrieval paths with reciprocal rank fusion, semantic atoms normalize every query

nodes.title: Heartbeat freshness
nodes.body: Heartbeat freshness guards single instance writes, stale heartbeat explains pid ownership honestly

nodes.title: Audit records
nodes.body: Audit records store hashes not payloads, every decision is reviewable with evidence pointers

nodes.title: Database migration
nodes.body: Database migration uses dual writes with backfill first, backup runs daily full plus incremental

nodes.title: Piano practice
nodes.body: The kid practices piano thirty minutes every day before playing, new piece assigned this saturday

nodes.title: Train tickets
nodes.body: High speed train tickets to the capital go on sale next month, buy the eight am window seat

nodes.title: Retirement plan
nodes.body: Father plans photography and fishing for retirement, renovating the old courtyard house

nodes.title: Cold verification
nodes.body: Cold verification enqueues after writes complete, replay requires the same fingerprint

nodes.title: Conflict gate
nodes.body: Conflict gate defers unmatched comparisons and records an audit entry, unmatched is honest

nodes.title: Umbrella repair
nodes.body: The broken umbrella frame will be fixed by friday, bring the receipt when picking it up
